description.narrative:
The Action-based learning for Narrative Power project stimulates learning and innovation on narrative approaches through pilots in three countries. The pilots aim to shift harmful narratives related to shrinking civic space in their particular context. In Tunisia, the project will support diverse civil society partners to strengthen their narrative capacities and develop a narrative-based campaign strategy, building on their newly developed toolkit on hope-based narratives. In El Salvador, the project will convene spaces for youth to develop and disseminate alternative narratives on civic space and climate justice. In Myanmar, the project will supporta partner organization to adopt creative dissemination strategies for rights-based narratives. The experiences from the country pilots will support learning on narrative approaches across the confederation, especially around alliance building for narrative power, innovative approaches to disseminate narratives, and measuring narrative change.
The project will strengthen narrative power of diverse civil society actors in Tunisia. It builds upon previous work to contextualize the hope-based narrative approach to Tunisia’scontext of rapidly shrinking civic space and to build narrative capacities among partners. The project will support a diverse groupof civil society actors to apply the newly developed toolkit on hope-based narratives by developing communication content and a dissemination strategy and to implement the strategy through a wide network of actors. Through several activities focused on reflection, learning and knowledge sharing, the project will ensure that the learning generated through the pilot will be shared widely.

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib registered in Tunisia in the end of 2011 and opened an office here early 2012. Oxfam#s work in the Maghreb is a multi country program comprising Morocco, Tunisia, Algeria and Libya. It supports local projects, is involved in lobby-work to take into account the interests of the poorest people, and campaigns to involve citizens in our work. It#s focus in the Maghreb is on social and political participation, gender justice and supporting sustainable livelihoods work. Four Oxfam affiliates work in the Maghreb:Oxfam Novib (The Netherlands), Intermon Oxfam (Spain), Oxfam Italy and Oxfam in Belgium. Oxfam has been working in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region for over five decades and over the past four decades promoting gender equality and supporting women#sright to participate and be represented in governance and decision-making structures and processes.
